description_en: Retrieves the token and WebSocket URL required to log on to a container
description_zh: 调用本接口可以获取登录到容器所需的 token 以及 websocket 地址
name: CreateServiceInstanceToken

parameters.help_en: The name of the service instance
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the service worker. You can call the ListServiceContainers operation to obtain the worker name
parameters.help_zh: 服务worker的名称。您可以调用ListServiceContainers接口获取worker名称
parameters.name: worker_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of connection to retrieve. Valid values:
WorkBench: Logs on to the container through the WorkBench page.
WebShell: Logs on to the container through a WebSocket URL. This option does not support processor-type services or services created before June 2026
parameters.help_zh:
需要获取的链接类型。取值：
WorkBench：通过WorkBench页面登录容器。
WebShell：通过websocket地址登录容器。不支持processor类型的服务和2026年6月前创建的服务
parameters.name: action_type
